<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  const el = document.getElementById('hero-last-updated');
  if (!el) return;
  const d = new Date(document.lastModified);
  el.textContent = 'Last updated: ' + d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
    year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric'
  });
});
</script>
<style>
/* hide Quarto's auto title block on this page */
#title-block-header { display: none !important; }

/* ── Hero ──────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.hero {
  background: #6E1C2E;
  color: #fff;
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--bs-border-radius-lg, .5rem);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hero-eyebrow {
  font-size: .75rem;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  opacity: .7;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}
.hero-title {
  font-size: 2rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.2;
  margin-bottom: .5rem;
}
.hero-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 1.2rem;
  font-size: .9rem;
  opacity: .85;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
.hero-meta span { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; }
.hero-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #fff;
  color: #6E1C2E !important;
  font-size: .875rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  padding: .45rem 1.1rem;
  border-radius: .375rem;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border: none;
}
.hero-btn:hover { background: #f0f0f0; color: #6E1C2E !important; }
.hero-btn-ghost {
  display: inline-block;
  background: transparent;
  color: #fff !important;
  font-size: .875rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: .45rem 1.1rem;
  border-radius: .375rem;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6);
  margin-left: .6rem;
}
.hero-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); color: #fff !important; }

/* ── Schedule cards ────────────────────────────────────────── */
.sched-cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: .85rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}
@media (max-width: 640px) { .sched-cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* Lecture is joint, so it spans the full width above the two lab sections. */
.sched-lecture { margin-bottom: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; }
.sched-lecture-inner {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sched-lecture-meta {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.sched-everyone {
  font-size: .72rem;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  font-style: italic;
}

/* Lecture on the left, the two labs stacked on the right, so the three cards
   read as one week rather than as a lecture and then a separate thing. */
.sched-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: .85rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  align-items: stretch;
}
.sched-labs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: .85rem;
}
/* One column on a phone: lecture, then Lab A, then Lab B. */
@media (max-width: 640px) { .sched-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

.sched-lab-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .6rem;
  margin-bottom: .4rem;
}
.sched-lab-head .sched-type { margin-bottom: .1rem; }
.sched-lab-head .sched-days { margin-bottom: 0; }
.sched-badge {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  border-radius: .4rem;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1;
}
.sched-badge-a { background: var(--calvin-maroon, #6E1C2E); color: #fff; }
.sched-badge-b { background: var(--calvin-gold, #C49A2C); color: #1a1a1a; }

.sched-card {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: .5rem;
  padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
}
.sched-type {
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  margin-bottom: .35rem;
}
.sched-days { font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .15rem; }
.sched-time { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); margin-bottom: .4rem; }
.sched-room {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: .72rem;
  background: var(--bs-secondary-bg);
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  padding: .15em .55em;
  border-radius: .25rem;
}

/* ── Bottom row ────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.bottom-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 220px 1fr;
  gap: .85rem;
}
@media (max-width: 640px) { .bottom-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

/* ── Instructor card ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.instructor-card {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: .5rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}
.avatar {
  width: 64px; height: 64px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #6E1C2E;
  color: #fff;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
/* The photo fills the circle and is cropped to it, so any reasonably square
   image works without being edited first. If figures/instructor.jpg is not
   there, the img removes itself and the initials come back. */
.avatar img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  display: block;
}
.instructor-name { font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: .3rem; }
.instructor-detail {
  font-size: .82rem;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  margin-bottom: .2rem;
}
.instructor-btns { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-top: 1rem; }
/* Office hours and the three window buttons are generated separately and were
   coming out at different widths and paddings. One rule covers all of them. */
.instructor-btns .btn,
.instructor-btns #checkin-book .btn {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  text-align: center;
  padding: .4rem .6rem;
  font-size: .8rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  white-space: normal;
}
/* The generated row is one flex item, so it needs its own column and the same
   gap to sit flush with the button above it. */
.instructor-btns #checkin-book {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 6px;
}

/* ── SLO card ──────────────────────────────────────────────── */
.slo-card {
  background: var(--bs-body-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: .5rem;
  padding: 1.25rem;
}
.slo-label {
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .07em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--bs-secondary-color);
  margin-bottom: .9rem;
}
.slo-list { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: .6rem; }
.slo-list li { display: flex; gap: .7rem; align-items: baseline; font-size: .9rem; }
.slo-num { font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; min-width: 18px; color: var(--bs-secondary-color); }
</style>

  function todayISO() {
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' +
           String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
           String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  // Current week, else the next one to start, else the last one. There is
  // always something to show; an empty block reads as a broken page.
  function pick(today) {
    for (var i = 0; i < WEEKS.length; i++) {
      if (WEEKS[i].start <= today && today <= WEEKS[i].end) {
        return { week: WEEKS[i], state: 'current' };
      }
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < WEEKS.length; j++) {
      if (WEEKS[j].start > today) {
        return { week: WEEKS[j], state: 'upcoming' };
      }
    }
    return { week: WEEKS[WEEKS.length - 1], state: 'past' };
  }

  function esc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, function (c) {
      return { '&': '&amp;', '<': '&lt;', '>': '&gt;', '"': '&quot;' }[c];
    });
  }

  function column(label, inner) {
    return '<div class="tw-col"><div class="tw-col-label">' + label +
           '</div>' + (inner || '<div class="tw-none">nothing posted yet</div>') +
           '</div>';
  }

  function render() {
    var host = document.getElementById('this-week');
    if (!host) return;
    var chosen = pick(todayISO());
    var w = chosen.week;

    var slides = '';
    if (w.slides) {
      var bits = ['<a href="' + w.slides.html + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">view online</a>'];
      if (w.slides.pdf) bits.push('<a href="' + w.slides.pdf + '">PDF</a>');
      if (w.slides.bw) bits.push('<a href="' + w.slides.bw + '">print</a>');
      slides = '<div class="tw-line">' +
               bits.join('<span class="tw-sep">·</span>') + '</div>';
    }

    var assign = w.assignments.map(function (a) {
      return '<div class="tw-line"><a class="tw-assign" href="' + a.href +
             '">' + esc(a.code) + ': ' + esc(a.title) + '</a></div>';
    }).join('');

    var outlines = w.outlines.map(function (o) {
      var line = '<div class="tw-line"><span class="tw-day">' + esc(o.day) +
                 '</span><a href="' + o.read + '">' + esc(o.date) + '</a>';
      if (o.booklet) {
        line += '<span class="tw-sep">·</span><a href="' + o.booklet +
                '">booklet</a>';
      }
      return line + '</div>';
    }).join('');

    var note = '';
    if (chosen.state === 'upcoming') note = 'Starting soon.';
    if (chosen.state === 'past') note = 'The last week of the semester.';

    host.innerHTML =
      '<div class="tw-head"><span class="tw-week">' + esc(w.label) +
      '</span><span class="tw-dates">' + esc(w.dates) + '</span></div>' +
      '<div class="tw-topic">' + esc(w.topic) + '</div>' +
      (note ? '<div class="tw-note">' + note + '</div>' : '') +
      '<div class="tw-cols">' +
        column('Slides', slides) +
        column('Assignment', assign) +
        column('Class outlines', outlines) +
      '</div>';
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', render);
  } else {
    render();
  }
})();
</script>

<!-- CHECKIN:START -->
<span id="checkin-book" data-checkins-href="content/checkins.html"><a href="content/checkins.html" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary">Book a check-in</a></span>
<script>
// One button per check-in window, each showing its own state, worked out in the
// browser from the visitor's clock. Nothing here is decided at build time, so
// the row stops being right only when checkin-windows.yml is wrong.
(function () {
  var WINDOWS = [{"n":1,"opens":"2026-09-29","reference":"2026-10-23","closes":"2026-12-09","opensLabel":"29 September","referenceLabel":"23 October","closesLabel":"9 December","url":"https://bookings.cloud.microsoft/book/AdvisingDays12@calvincollege.onmicrosoft.com/s/Tx-rOrayH0aWDoFY8HXavw2?ismsaljsauthenabled"},{"n":2,"opens":"2026-10-26","reference":"2026-11-20","closes":"2026-12-09","opensLabel":"26 October","referenceLabel":"20 November","closesLabel":"9 December","url":null},{"n":3,"opens":"2026-11-16","reference":"2026-12-02","closes":"2026-12-09","opensLabel":"16 November","referenceLabel":"2 December","closesLabel":"9 December","url":null}];

  function todayISO() {
    var d = new Date();
    return d.getFullYear() + '-' +
           String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' +
           String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
  }

  var LIVE = 'background:#6E1C2E;color:#fff;border-color:#6E1C2E;';
  var MUTED = 'opacity:.55;cursor:default;';

  function button(w, today, fallback) {
    // Open, and the link exists. The only one a student can act on.
    if (w.opens <= today && today <= w.closes && w.url) {
      return '<a href="' + w.url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" ' +
             'class="btn btn-sm" style="' + LIVE + '" ' +
             'title="Assessed against ' + w.referenceLabel +
             '. Closes ' + w.closesLabel + '.">' +
             'Book Window ' + w.n + '</a>';
    }

    // Everything else is shown anyway, greyed, so a student can see the shape
    // of the semester rather than wondering what happened to the other windows.
    var label;
    if (today > w.closes)        label = 'Window ' + w.n + ' closed';
    else if (today < w.opens)    label = 'Window ' + w.n + ' opens ' + w.opensLabel;
    else                         label = 'Window ' + w.n + ' link coming';

    return '<a href="' + fallback + '" class="btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary" ' +
           'style="' + MUTED + '" title="Assessed against ' + w.referenceLabel +
           '.">' + label + '</a>';
  }

  function render() {
    var host = document.getElementById('checkin-book');
    if (!host) return;
    var today = todayISO();
    var fallback = host.getAttribute('data-checkins-href') || 'content/checkins.html';
    host.innerHTML = WINDOWS.map(function (w) {
      return button(w, today, fallback);
    }).join(' ');
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', render);
  } else {
    render();
  }
})();
</script>
<!-- CHECKIN:END -->
    </div>
  </div>

    </ul>
  </div>
</div>
